description: This file defines a React component page for a journey or roadmap visualization in a web application. It includes various UI components, data models, and interactive visualizations such as mind maps and lifecycle stages related to career planning, skill development, and milestones.

classes.name: RoadmapTab
classes.description: String union type representing selected tabs or views in the roadmap interface.

classes.name: SkillDelta
classes.description: Data structure representing a skill change with current and target levels.

classes.name: MilestoneStatus
classes.description: Type representing the status of a milestone ('Not started', 'In progress', or 'Done').

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Object representing a milestone in the career roadmap, with title, date, description, status, tags, and stage.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Data structure aggregating role information, skill deltas, and milestones for career planning.

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Enum for skill health status ('Strong', 'Gap', 'In progress').

classes.name: MindMapSubNode
classes.description: Sub-node in a mind map representing a skill or action with a label and status.

classes.name: MindMapCategory
classes.description: Category node in the mind map grouping related skills/sub-nodes with visual properties.

classes.name: MindMapNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the interactive mind map, with position, label, size, and tooltip info.

classes.name: MindMapEdge
classes.description: Represents a connection edge between mind map nodes, with color and weight.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string as string array.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date as ISO string (yyyy-mm-dd).

methods.name: ProgressPill
methods.description: React component displaying a percentage badge with color coding.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates progress summary (total, done, inProgress, percent) for milestones.

methods.name: progressRingTone
methods.description: Returns color values for progress ring based on percentage.

methods.name: stageIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG icons for different stage indicators ('flag', 'lightning', 'target').

methods.name: normalizeMilestonesForPathway
methods.description: Augments milestones with stage classification for pathway visualization.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom hook to detect if user prefers reduced motion for accessibility.

methods.name: useIntersectionReveal
methods.description: Custom hook to set up intersection observer for reveal animations.

methods.name: ProgressRing
methods.description: React component showing a circular progress indicator.

methods.name: TagChip
methods.description: UI component for tagging milestones/actions.

methods.name: StageNode
methods.description: Component representing a career stage node with icon, progress, and status.

methods.name: MilestoneCard
methods.description: UI card for individual milestone items with toggle completion.

methods.name: PathwayCareerTimeline
methods.description: Component showing milestones organized into 'now', 'near', 'next' stages with progress.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default role plan with predefined milestones and skills based on inputs.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads the roadmap state (active role, plans) from local storage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to local storage.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Generates categories and subnodes for a role in a mind map based on role id and title.

methods.name: categoryIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG icon components for different category labels.

methods.name: curvedPath
methods.description: Creates a curved SVG path between two points with specified curvature.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Generates nodes and edges for the mind map visualization given categories and layout parameters.
